== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will use this spell when they are below 80% energy and they can gain at least 6 energy from the closest spirit.

==Notes==
* Spirits have four [[pip]]s of [[energy regeneration]]; they regain their maximum energy (30 energy) in about 23 seconds.
** In [[Hard mode]], enemy spirits have 41 energy, making them a better source.
** Spirits do not use energy to attack, so Spirit Siphon will not reduce their effectiveness.
* When used on multiple spirits, this skill allows for better energy returns over [[Offering of Spirit]] or [[Signet of Spirits (PvP)]].
* This skill always [[target]]s the spirit closest to the caster. If two or more spirits are equal distance, the target is chosen at random.
** There is no effect unless the closest spirit is within [[casting range]]; however, the skill will activate (and waste energy) with spirits outside of casting range or without spirits at all.

== Trivia ==
